panels.title: Tempo restarts (1h)
panels.description: changes(process_start_time_seconds{job=tempo}[1h]). The OOM-restart that caused the ~69% span drop. Should be 0.

panels.title: Prometheus restarts (1h)
panels.description: changes(process_start_time_seconds{job=prometheus}[1h]). Prometheus OOM'd on WAL replay under high per-test cardinality. Should be 0.

panels.title: Spans accepted − filtered − sent (24h)
panels.description: Spans the collector accepted but neither filtered on purpose nor sent to Tempo, over 24h. Anything well above zero is spans lost or stuck in the queue.

panels.title: Collector queue & send failures
panels.description: Exporter queue depth vs capacity and failed sends. This is the durability layer that absorbs a Tempo restart — rising queue = buffering, send_failed > 0 = dropping.

panels.title: Tempo discarded spans by reason (1h)
panels.description: sum by(reason)(increase(tempo_discarded_spans_total[1h])). trace_too_large / live_traces_exceeded confirm whether loss is limit-based. Should stay 0.

panels.title: Tempo write path (spans in / blocks flushed)
panels.description: Spans received by the distributor vs blocks flushed to disk by the ingester. Replaces the old unit-mismatched spans-minus-traces rate.

panels.title: End-to-end span reconciliation (collector)
panels.description: Spans per second into the collector, out to Tempo, and dropped by the privacy filter. A gap beyond the filtered rate is span loss.

panels.title: Tempo memory (RSS) vs 16 GiB limit
panels.description: Tempo's resident memory against its 16 GiB limit. An OOMKill here loses spans that were accepted but not yet flushed.

panels.title: Tempo live traces (in-RAM)
panels.description: Concurrent traces held in the ingester's RAM. A sharded run holds many wide live traces at once; high counts drive the memory in the panel to the left toward the OOM limit.

panels.title: Prometheus memory (RSS) vs 8 GiB limit
panels.description: Prometheus resident memory vs its 8 GiB cgroup limit. It OOM'd on WAL replay under high per-test series cardinality. Mirror of the Tempo RSS panel.
Traces the exporter could not read back from Tempo, by reason. A too_large trace is skipped whole, so its job is missing from the run.
panels.title: Trace read failures — dropped jobs (too_large)
Backup last success age
panels.description: Hours since each backup CronJob last completed successfully. Daily backups should stay below ~30h.

panels.title: Backup last schedule age
panels.description: Hours since each backup CronJob was last scheduled.

panels.title: Backup latest job problems
panels.description: Backup CronJobs whose latest job failed, is missing or is in an unknown state. 0 is healthy.

panels.title: Backup active jobs
panels.description: Currently active backup Jobs by CronJob. Normally zero except while the daily backup is running.

panels.title: Backup latest job status
panels.description: One row per backup CronJob latest status. Status should be succeeded after the daily run finishes.
Trace data Tempo received per UTC day. Today's bar is partial.
panels.title: Trace data received per day

panels.description: Metric samples each Prometheus stored per UTC day (prometheus holds CI data, prometheus-infra the stack's own metrics). Today's bar is partial.
panels.title: Metric samples ingested per day

panels.description: AWS CI runner executions per UTC day, one per pytest trace. Today's bar is partial.
panels.title: AWS runner executions per day
PVC on-disk usage vs limit
panels.description: Disk used by Tempo and Prometheus against their volume sizes.
Grafana HTTP requests plus trace-exporter helper-page requests, averaged over 5 minutes.
panels.title: Frontend requests/min

panels.description: Top Grafana routes and custom trace-exporter pages. Badge/summary/run/failure are the public anonymous-click surfaces routed to trace-exporter by kube ingress.
panels.title: Requests/min by route

panels.description: Rendered-response cache activity for badge and summary endpoints. Hits avoid re-reading and scanning the full metrics payload for repeated anonymous requests.
panels.title: Badge/summary cache activity
Deliveries rejected (1h)
panels.description: Bad signatures or store errors. Nonzero = investigate.

panels.title: Webhook deliveries by outcome
panels.description: Per minute.

panels.title: Reconciliation: cycles and repairs (5m)
panels.description: Repairs are what the webhooks missed (or had not delivered within a cycle). A first start backfills, so it repairs a lot once.

panels.title: GitHub events / min
panels.description: GitHub webhook events received per minute. Zero while CI is busy means GitHub stopped delivering.

panels.title: GitHub events per minute, by event and action
panels.description: GitHub webhook events per minute, by event and action.
